resources.string: Independent school access is off until you allow it for a watch.
Independent watch access is unavailable in demo mode. Connect your own school account on this phone to review access for a nearby watch.
Watch access could not be updated. Check the phone and watch connection, then refresh and try again.
Access is allowed for seven days. Keep Gradey open on the nearby watch while it receives your school sign-in.
Access was turned off on this phone. The watch clears its school sign-in and data when it receives the update. Until then, it can work until the original expiry.
Independent access is unavailable for the current school session. Reconnect your school account on this phone, then refresh.
Pair your watch with this phone, open Gradey on the watch and keep it nearby. Then refresh this list.
Access lasts seven days. Turning it off or switching accounts clears the watch when it reconnects; a disconnected watch may keep working until access expires.
An encrypted copy of your current school username and password will be stored on this watch. It can connect directly to your school and refresh school data without your phone.
Allow access for seven days. You can renew it here while the watch is nearby. This does not enable independent AI chat.
Turning access off, signing out or switching accounts clears the school sign-in and data when the watch reconnects. A disconnected watch can keep working until the original expiry.
Turn-off takes effect when this watch receives an update. Bring it nearby to renew access.
